messages.subject: multiple axis labels
parts:
I would like to display labels at each end of the x-axis. The top label
is one unit of measure and the bottom label is a second unit of measure
(cm and in, in this case). I can do this in a fashion with text
annotations. I there a way to do this with scales?

Thanks

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: multiple axis labels
parts:
Hi,

Maybe you could hack a little function to do it,

foo = function(...) function(label, x = hj, y = vj, ..., vjust = vj,
hjust = hj, default.units = "npc") {labs =
strsplit(label,"\\n")[[1]]; gTree(children=gList(textGrob(labs[1],0),
textGrob(labs[2],1)))}

qplot(1,1) + opts(axis.title.x = foo()) + xlab("test\ntest2")


HTH,

baptiste
